author: Ashley Claudy
tagline: New Adult romance with fast cars, hard hits, and love that breaks the rules.
meta_description: Ashley Claudy writes New Adult romance: street racers and motorcycle clubs in Crowns & Chaos, boxing and danger in Outside the Ropes, and college football in Hustle. Read free in Kindle Unlimited.
bio: Ashley Claudy writes New Adult romance about people who live a little too fast and love a little too hard: street racers, fighters, football players, and the women who can hold their own against all of them.
She's a mom, a wife, and a teacher. A perpetual learner fueled by coffee and a wild imagination, a proud University of Maryland alum, a late-night book junkie and a daytime dreamer.
